items.headline: Sabre Financial Borrower reports early tender results for cash tender offer and consent solicitation
items.summary: Sabre Corporation said its indirect wholly-owned subsidiary, Sabre Financial Borrower, LLC, announced early tender results for a previously announced cash tender offer and consent solicitation. The announcement, made Thursday from Southlake, Texas, did not disclose the amount tendered or the notes involved.
items.why_it_matters: The tender and consent process points to Sabre continuing to actively manage its debt stack, a step credit investors watch closely for a travel-technology company operating with a leveraged balance sheet.

items.headline: Sunwest Bank acquires failed Nano Banc in FDIC-assisted transaction
items.summary: Sunwest Bank has acquired Nano Banc of Irvine, California, after the FDIC accepted receivership of the lender from California's Department of Financial Protection and Innovation. The FDIC named Sunwest as Nano Banc's acquiring institution; financial terms were not disclosed.
items.why_it_matters: The FDIC-assisted sale shows regulators moving to place a failed lender with an acquirer rather than winding it down, limiting disruption to depositors and to the broader regional banking system.
